Helper-claimed by Codex2 while Codex completes higher-priority work.

Kraken websocket subscription, websocket/rest execution-sync reconciliation, and replay metadata propagation are implemented. Verification: python3 -m unittest services.execution.test_kraken_adapter -v (10/10 pass) and python3 -m unittest services.data-plane.tests.test_data_plane_schemas -v (53/53 pass). Please review the Kraken adapter and crypto reference join changes for acceptance.

Review returned to owner: Kraken pair parsing/reference join still fail outside the hard-coded quote list. Repro: python3 -c "from services.execution.kraken_adapter import normalize_kraken_symbol; print(normalize_kraken_symbol('MATICGBP'))" raises ValueError('unsupported Kraken pair: MATICGBP'), and join_kraken_quote_with_reference raises KeyError('missing CoinGecko metadata for MATICGBP') for MATIC/GBP.KRAKEN. Please generalize Kraken quote parsing/base-asset extraction before re-handoff.

Kraken pair parsing/base-asset extraction now uses a shared helper across execution + data-plane, covering non-hardcoded quote suffixes like MATICGBP. Verified with python3 -m pytest services/execution/test_kraken_adapter.py services/data-plane/tests/test_data_plane_schemas.py -q (64 passed) plus direct repros for normalize_kraken_symbol('MATICGBP') and join_kraken_quote_with_reference on MATICGBP.
Reviewer verified shared Kraken pair parsing, websocket-backed execution sync metadata, and the MATICGBP join repro; approved for owner finalization.
